purpose: Define, before activation, how each conditional spatial preference would be measured, compared, held, and restored without presenting targets as results.

baseline.ordinary_no_ai_condition: continuous public garden and step-free route with no autonomous test bay
baseline.observation_location_rule: measure the full candidate line at 5 m chainage and every pinch point; observe both public and logistics edges
baseline.comparison: before/after with the ordinary no-AI route kept open as the concurrent control

sample_plan.unit: booked staffed session plus continuous ordinary-route observation
sample_plan.minimum: six sessions across at least three dates, including one weekend window; every active session remains logged
sample_plan.frequency: baseline on two weekdays and one weekend; during every session; weekly independent review

methods: tape or laser width record at each chainage and pinch point
anonymous manual count of route interruptions; no face or device identifier
preregistered_pass: ordinary clear-route design target >= 3.0 m at every measured point
zero unauthorized logistics encroachment during active sessions
10/10 offline stop drills hand back control within 30 seconds before public activation
hold: absent duty owner or safety officer
failed stop drill or missing measurement
measurement.missing_or_anomalous_data: HOLD; preserve the no-AI garden, record the gap, and repeat the affected window without imputation

roles.signatory: named site operator plus affected-public representative

protocols.restore: remove the test bay and reopen the ordinary garden route

baseline.ordinary_no_ai_condition: open daily lane, paper consultation, and non-AI public display
baseline.observation_location_rule: audit every activated source-window, rights-desk, and withdrawal-table record; measure the ordinary route at every threshold
baseline.comparison: before/after record audit with the paper and staffed no-AI service retained as the concurrent control

sample_plan.unit: public output record or synthetic withdrawal rehearsal
sample_plan.minimum: 20 synthetic records and 10 withdrawal rehearsals before activation; 100% of public outputs after activation
sample_plan.frequency: pre-activation tabletop; per output; weekly independent rights review

methods: five-field record audit for source, licence, human contact, version, and withdrawal state
threshold width record with no visitor identity collection
preregistered_pass: 100% of public outputs expose all five rights fields
10/10 synthetic withdrawal rehearsals remove the recommendation and retain a paper receipt
ordinary clear-route design target >= 3.0 m at every measured threshold
hold: any missing source or licence field
ordinary route blocked or human desk unstaffed
measurement.missing_or_anomalous_data: HOLD the affected output; retain the non-AI display and paper service; do not infer a pass from other records

roles.signatory: named campus operator plus affected contributor/public representative

protocols.restore: withdraw the AI recommendation and retain an open non-AI public arcade

baseline.ordinary_no_ai_condition: phone-free ground service with two staffed desks and continuous accessibility
baseline.observation_location_rule: survey the 98.6 m desktop candidate at 5 m chainage and every doorway, tactile-paving, drainage, fire, loading, road, and rail pinch point
baseline.comparison: before/after installation with the two staffed no-AI desks and ordinary ground route retained as the concurrent control

sample_plan.unit: chainage station, handover drill, active shift, or full removal-and-restoration drill
sample_plan.minimum: all 5 m chainage stations plus every pinch point; 10 handover drills; one complete removal drill before activation
sample_plan.frequency: before set-out; before every opening; continuous shift log; weekly independent review; after removal

methods: tape or laser width record at chainage and pinch points
stopwatch handover drill using synthetic service cases
installation/removal time log and paired surface-condition photographs without faces or vehicle plates
preregistered_pass: ordinary clear-route design target >= 3.0 m at every measured point
10/10 offline handover drills <= 30 seconds before activation
paper service and appeal receipt available for every active shift
zero visible surface damage on the paired restoration checklist
hold: any blocked route or unresolved fire/loading conflict
absent duty owner or human operator
failed handover, missing paper receipt, failed removal drill, complaint red line, or missing evidence
measurement.missing_or_anomalous_data: HOLD; keep AI off, retain two staffed desks, log the gap, and repeat the affected measurement without imputation

desktop_reference_interval.coordinate_method: centered on the 98.6 m CT-03-C desktop line solely to show one 12 m module in the same coordinate frame
desktop_reference_interval.relocation_or_cancel_rule: after the 0-30 day field survey, move within the candidate or cancel if any doorway, tactile paving, drainage, fire, loading, road, rail, ownership, or ordinary-route condition fails

inquiry_ready_validation_unit.dimensional_rule: all six component types must fit inside the 12.0 m by 2.4 m conditional side-band while preserving the separate 3.0 m ordinary route; exact component dimensions and heights remain null until professional and supplier review

components.requirement: freestanding, ballasted, no drilling or adhesive, rounded edges
one standing and one accessible service position; dimensions require professional accessibility review
human-operable, visible, passive or <=24 V DC; powered parts target minimum IP54 subject to engineer confirmation

components.item: paper appeal and rollback receipt stations
components.requirement: works without phone, account, face recognition, or network
supplier-declared outdoor durability, reusable fixings, labelled inventory

components.item: ordinary-route set-out and tactile-edge protection kit
components.requirement: does not cover tactile paving, drainage, fire, loading, or building entrances

inquiry_ready_validation_unit.installation_requirement: supplier declares crew and method; one full offline installation and removal rehearsal required before activation
inquiry_ready_validation_unit.quotation_rule: three comparable inquiry slots; no purchase order is authorized and currency values remain null until genuine supplier quotations are obtained

roles.reviewer: accessibility, fire, transport, heritage, and independent evaluation reviewers
roles.signatory: named street operator plus affected-public representative after professional clearance

protocols.restore: inventory, disconnect, remove the plug-in kit, document the surface, and restore two staffed ordinary-service desks
